notes: WTevo = 40-day sertraline-evolved lines; controls = lines passaged 40 days in TSB without sertraline (labelled reference/control). Not stated whether sertraline was present at harvest, so treatment left out for WTevo. No growth phase, OD or aeration given. Strain labels removed 2026-11-20: GEO states K-12 MG1655, but the counts show about 500 MG1655 genes without reads in every sample and 1-2.5% of reads off the MG1655 reference; the same pattern as in GSE275262 and GSE343594 (79% of the missing genes shared). The strain is not MG1655 and is not identified, so strain_group and strain_name are left empty.
